libraries.name: Font Awesome
libraries.note: Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1. CSS: MIT. The documentation (CC-BY-3.0) is not shipped.

libraries.name: @vue/compiler-dom (Node build, bundled for QuickJS)
libraries.build: esbuild --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=VueCompilerDOM --platform=node --target=es2020 with NODE_ENV=production, source-map-js aliased to a stub that throws (only used for sourceMap:true), and an atob shim injected (QuickJS has no atob; entities decodes its tables with it at load). Exposes the global VueCompilerDOM. No Node builtins are required.

libraries.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (variable, latin and latin-ext)
Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono (variable, latin and latin-ext)
world-atlas (Natural Earth 110m countries)
libraries.note: The map data is Natural Earth 4.1.0, in the public domain (https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/).

libraries.name: unicode-emoji-json
libraries.note: The package is MIT; the emoji data in it is from unicode.org, under the Unicode License v3.
libraries.build: data-by-group.json made into {version, groups: [{slug, name, emoji: [[emoji, name]]}]}, the emoji of emoji_version 15.1 or earlier, in the order of the file.

libraries.name: Mermaid
libraries.license: MIT AND ISC AND BSD-3-Clause AND Apache-2.0
libraries.note: Mermaid core and its locked dependencies, bundled locally. DOMPurify is used under Apache-2.0.
libraries.build: esbuild of mermaid.core.mjs with the locked DOMPurify and KaTeX packages

libraries.name: Marked
libraries.build: esbuild --minify --legal-comments=none on lib/marked.umd.js (a transform, no bundling), banner kept as one line.

libraries.name: highlight.js
libraries.build: esbuild --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=hljs of lib/core plus the languages bash, css, diff, groovy, java, javascript, json, kotlin, markdown, plaintext, python, rust, sql, typescript, xml, yaml. Exposes the global hljs.

libraries.name: Tiptap (with ProseMirror, bundled)
libraries.note: Bundles @tiptap/core, starter-kit (and the extensions it includes), extension-link, extension-image, extension-mention, extension-placeholder, extension-table, extension-table-row, extension-table-cell, extension-table-header, extension-collaboration, extension-collaboration-caret, extensions, suggestion and pm 3.31.4, the prosemirror-* packages, @tiptap/y-tiptap, yjs, y-protocols, lib0, isomorphic.js, @floating-ui/*, linkifyjs, orderedmap, rope-sequence and w3c-keyname: all MIT. Each license text is below once, with the packages it is the license of.
libraries.build: esbuild --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=Tiptap --platform=browser --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none of an entry that exports Editor, Extension, Node, Mark, mergeAttributes, StarterKit, Link, Image, Mention, Placeholder, Table, TableRow, TableCell, TableHeader, PluginKey, Collaboration, CollaborationCaret, Y (the yjs namespace), Awareness, encodeAwarenessUpdate, applyAwarenessUpdate and removeAwarenessStates. Exposes the global Tiptap.

libraries.name: CodeMirror 6 (bundled)
libraries.note: Bundles @codemirror/state, view, language, commands, search, autocomplete, lint, merge, streamparser, lang-xml, lang-javascript, lang-markdown, lang-json, lang-css, lang-html, lang-vue, lang-sql, lang-yaml and lang-rust, the @lezer/* parsers they use, @marijn/find-cluster-break, crelt, style-mod, w3c-keyname and @replit/codemirror-indentation-markers: all MIT. Each license text is below once, with the packages it is the license of.
libraries.build: esbuild --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=CodeMirror --platform=browser --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none of an entry (CODEMIRROR_ENTRY) that exports the state, view, commands, search, autocomplete, lint, language and merge APIs, the language packages, the highlight tags and indentationMarkers. Exposes the global CodeMirror.

libraries.name: OpenUI Lang core (bundled with zod)
libraries.note: Bundles @openuidev/lang-core and the parts of zod 4.6.6 it uses (MIT). Patched: patches/openui-lang-core-0.2.18-telemetry-off.patch, patches/openui-lang-core-0.2.18-failed-query.patch (telemetry off; a failed Query is not fetched again until its arguments change).
libraries.build: the patches applied with patch -p1 to the installed package, then esbuild --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=OpenUILang --platform=browser --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none of an entry that exports createParser, createStreamingParser, mergeStatements, createStore, createQueryManager, evaluate, evaluateElementProps, BuiltinActionType, ACTION_STEPS, walkAST, tokenize, split, parseExpression, BUILTIN_NAMES and ACTION_NAMES. Exposes the global OpenUILang; the build fails when the bundle names a telemetry host, a process call or a network call of its own.

libraries.name: PDF.js
libraries.note: Only the display and worker modules. The standard_fonts (Foxit fonts under a BSD license, Liberation fonts under GPL-2.0 with a font exception), cmaps, iccs and wasm directories are not shipped.

libraries.name: rrweb
libraries.note: The UMD bundle includes rrweb-snapshot, rrdom, @rrweb/types, @rrweb/utils, mitt, base64-arraybuffer and @xstate/fsm, all MIT.

libraries.name: QZ Tray connector (qz-tray.js)
libraries.note: The file is served unmodified as its own script, and only when printing is enabled. Never concatenated or minified into another file.

libraries.name: matrix-sdk-crypto-wasm
libraries.license: Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND ISC AND Zlib AND Unicode-3.0 AND BSL-1.0 AND MPL-2.0
libraries.note: The package is Apache-2.0. Its WebAssembly module has 240 Rust crates inside (a dual license taken on its permissive side); each, with its version, license and license text, is in licenses/matrix-sdk-crypto-wasm-18.9.0-crates.txt. Seven are MPL-2.0 (as_variant, eyeball, eyeball-im, readlock, readlock-tokio, imbl, imbl-sized-chunks), unmodified: their source is on crates.io at the versions listed there.

libraries.name: Excalidraw editor and Mermaid converter
libraries.license: MIT AND MIT-Modern-Variant AND Apache-2.0 AND 0BSD AND CC0-1.0 AND Zlib AND OFL-1.1
